file_stem: RWB E1 008 Decision log store append only and hash chained
title: Decision log store v1, append only and hash chained
goal: A tamper-evident, append-only store that keeps every decision once, so any later change is detected
why: Audit and Compliance must trust the decision log. Each entry hashes the previous one, and the database refuses UPDATE and DELETE.
ace_note: No ACE read. The decision log is pure Workbench data: it records the rule, version and inputs behind each action.

reads.note: last chain_seq and hash; range checks

stores: PostgreSQL advisory lock 'decision_log_chain'; trigger tr_declog_append_only; ACE incident path and notification to Compliance
rules: BR2: never update or delete; a correction is a new entry naming the one it corrects
BR3: one chain; the first entry's prev_hash is 64 zeros
BR4: SHA-256 lowercase hex of canonical JSON with sorted keys
BR5: append is the caller's last statement, so action and entry commit together
risks: UPDATE or DELETE attempted -> refused: 'decision_log_entry is append only'
Tampered entry -> break named, incident, Compliance told within 15 min (MSG-P7-008)
Store unwritable -> the caller's action rolls back (MSG-P7-003)
example: chain_seq 1 | case RW-2026-000123 | final call OWNER_ASSIGNED | prev_hash 000...000
